title: Menning 2005 · tactile priming of auditory attention
citation: Menning, H., Ackermann, H., Hertrich, I., & Mathiak, K. (2005). Spatial auditory attention is modulated by tactile priming. Experimental Brain Research, 164(1), 41–47.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

sound.kind: HRTF-filtered white noise from air tubes

schedule.baseline: Unprimed sound events at all four audio positions.

published_method.response: No speeded auditory or tactile response. The participant performs the ongoing visual distraction task. Analyze MEG responses time-locked to sound and compare source side, source region and priming.

source_provenance.gap: Original files and random seed unavailable.

trajectory_path.gap: No continuous trajectory in the reported cueing design.

baseline_strategy.value: Compare auditory responses following tactile primes with responses to sounds without a preceding tactile cue.
baseline_strategy.source: Experimental Brain Research pp. 42–43, Participants, Stimuli, Distraction tasks and Fig. 1; Experimental Brain Research p. 43, Data acquisition and Data analysis
baseline_strategy.gap: Unprimed responses are plotted. Comparator scheduling and counts require the journal methods.

baseline_timing.source: Menning et al. 2005, Experimental Brain Research pp. 42–43, Distraction tasks and Data analysis
baseline_timing.gap: Sound-only sweeps omit the tactile prime. The 400 ms pre-sound window belongs to MEG data analysis. No separate baseline-only timing policy is described.

catch_trial_type.value: No explicit catch family is described for the auditory–tactile stream. Visual targets belong to the separate distractor task.
catch_trial_type.source: Journal pp. 42–43, Distraction tasks and Fig. 1
catch_trial_type.gap: Audio/tactile and visual events overlap; visual targets do not define auditory catches.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.source: Journal p. 43, Data acquisition and Data analysis
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: 90 sweeps per site pair. Counts at individual cue-lead values were not reported.

baseline_count.source: Experimental Brain Research pp. 42–43, Participants, Stimuli, Distraction tasks and Fig. 1; Experimental Brain Research p. 43, Data acquisition and Data analysis

catch_count.source: Menning et al. 2005, Experimental Brain Research pp. 42–43, Distraction tasks and Data analysis
catch_count.gap: Sound-only sweeps are MEG baseline trials. Participants disregard the auditory and tactile events. Visual-task non-targets are a separate response stream with no catch quota reported.

implementation_gaps: The participant-selected spatial filters and original MATLAB output, air-tube and pneumatic calibration, audio trigger codes and exact stimulus streams are unavailable.

This passive main task requires synchronized presentation of tactile primes and sound, a concurrent visual distractor with separate responses, and whole-head MEG. The runtime does not schedule or acquire this combination.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
